cve_summary: FFmpeg before 2.8.12, 3.0.x and 3.1.x before 3.1.9, 3.2.x before 3.2.6, and 3.3.x before 3.3.2 does not properly restrict HTTP Live Streaming filename extensions and demuxer names, which allows attackers to read arbitrary files via crafted playlist data.
commit_message:
avformat/avidec: Limit formats in gab2 to srt and ass/ssa

This prevents part of one exploit leading to an information leak

Found-by: Emil Lerner and Pavel Cheremushkin
Reported-by: Thierry Foucu <tfoucu@google.com>

Signed-off-by: Michael Niedermayer <michael@niedermayer.cc>
docstring:
"""
Summary: 
Reads a GAB2 subtitle packet and initializes the corresponding AVStream with the subtitle context.

Parameters: 
s (AVFormatContext *): The format context for the input file.
st (AVStream *): The stream to which the subtitle data belongs.
pkt (AVPacket *): The packet containing the subtitle data.

Returns: 
int: Returns 1 on successful reading and initialization of the subtitle context, or 0 on failure.

Logic: 
The function checks if the packet size is valid and if it contains the GAB2 identifier. It then allocates an AVIOContext for reading the subtitle data, extracts metadata, and checks the format of the subtitle. If the format is valid, it allocates a new context for the subtitle stream, copies necessary parameters, and sets the presentation timestamp information. In case of any errors during the process, it cleans up allocated resources and returns 0.
"""
